questions.subunit: Properties and conditions of isosceles triangles
questions.question: Which of the following is the correct definition of an isosceles triangle?
choices: A triangle with two equal sides
A triangle with two equal angles
A triangle with three equal sides
A triangle with one right angle
questions.answer: A triangle with two equal sides
questions.explanation: The definition of an isosceles triangle is 'a triangle with two equal sides.' The fact that the two base angles are equal is a property (theorem) derived from the definition.

questions.subunit: Properties and conditions of isosceles triangles
questions.question: In isosceles triangle ABC with AB=AC, if the vertex angle ∠A=40°, what is the measure of the base angle ∠B, in degrees?
questions.explanation: Since the base angles are equal, ∠B=∠C=(180°-40°)÷2=70°.

questions.subunit: Properties and conditions of isosceles triangles
questions.question: In isosceles triangle ABC with AB=AC, if the base angle ∠B=65°, what is the measure of the vertex angle ∠A, in degrees?

questions.subunit: Properties and conditions of isosceles triangles
questions.question: Which of the following is true about the bisector of the vertex angle of an isosceles triangle?
choices: It is parallel to the base
questions.explanation: The bisector of the vertex angle of an isosceles triangle perpendicularly bisects the base (it becomes the perpendicular bisector).

questions.subunit: Properties and conditions of isosceles triangles
questions.question: In △ABC, if ∠B=∠C, what can be said about this triangle?
choices: It is an isosceles triangle with AB=AC
It is an isosceles triangle with AB=BC
questions.answer: It is an isosceles triangle with AB=AC
questions.explanation: In a triangle with two equal angles, the sides opposite those angles (the sides facing the equal angles) are equal, so it is an isosceles triangle. The side opposite ∠B is AC, and the side opposite ∠C is AB.

questions.question: What is the measure of one interior angle of an equilateral triangle, in degrees?
questions.explanation: Since all three angles are equal, 180°÷3=60°.

questions.question: Which of the following is the correct definition of an equilateral triangle?
choices: A triangle with three equal sides
A triangle with three equal angles
A triangle with two equal sides
A triangle whose interior angles sum to 180°
questions.answer: A triangle with three equal sides
questions.explanation: The definition of an equilateral triangle is 'a triangle with three equal sides.' The fact that all three angles are equal at 60° is a property.

questions.question: In a right triangle, what is the side opposite the right angle (the longest side) called?
questions.explanation: The side opposite the right angle in a right triangle is called the hypotenuse.

questions.question: One congruence condition for right triangles is 'the hypotenuse and one acute angle are respectively equal.' Which of the following is the other one?
choices: The hypotenuse and one other side are respectively equal
The two acute angles are respectively equal
The three angles are respectively equal
questions.answer: The hypotenuse and one other side are respectively equal
questions.explanation: The two congruence conditions for right triangles are 'the hypotenuse and one acute angle' and 'the hypotenuse and one other side.'

questions.question: When two right triangles have equal hypotenuses and one pair of equal acute angles, what can be said about the two triangles?
choices: They are similar but not necessarily congruent
questions.explanation: Since 'the hypotenuse and one acute angle are respectively equal' is a congruence condition for right triangles, they are congruent.

questions.question: Which of the following is the correct definition of a parallelogram?
choices: A quadrilateral in which both pairs of opposite sides are parallel
A quadrilateral in which both pairs of opposite sides are equal
A quadrilateral whose diagonals are equal
A quadrilateral in which all four angles are equal
questions.answer: A quadrilateral in which both pairs of opposite sides are parallel
questions.explanation: The definition of a parallelogram is 'both pairs of opposite sides are parallel.' The fact that opposite sides are equal is a property.

questions.question: In parallelogram ABCD, if AB=6 cm, what is the length of the opposite side CD, in cm? Answer with the number only.
questions.explanation: Since opposite sides of a parallelogram are equal, CD=AB=6 cm.

questions.question: In parallelogram ABCD, if ∠A=110°, what is the measure of the opposite angle ∠C, in degrees?
questions.explanation: Since opposite angles of a parallelogram are equal, ∠C=∠A=110°.

questions.question: In parallelogram ABCD, if ∠A=110°, what is the measure of the adjacent angle ∠B, in degrees?
questions.explanation: The sum of adjacent angles in a parallelogram is 180°. 180°-110°=70°.

questions.question: Which of the following is true about the diagonals of a parallelogram?
questions.explanation: The diagonals of a parallelogram intersect at their midpoints. Being equal in length is a property of a rectangle, and intersecting perpendicularly is a property of a rhombus.

questions.question: Let O be the intersection of the diagonals of parallelogram ABCD. If AC=10 cm, what is the length of AO, in cm? Answer with the number only.
questions.explanation: Since the diagonals intersect at their midpoints, AO=10÷2=5 cm.

questions.subunit: Conditions for a quadrilateral to be a parallelogram
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a valid condition for a quadrilateral to be a parallelogram?
choices: One pair of opposite sides is parallel, and the other pair of opposite sides is equal
Both pairs of opposite sides are equal
The diagonals intersect at their midpoints
One pair of opposite sides is parallel and equal
questions.answer: One pair of opposite sides is parallel, and the other pair of opposite sides is equal
questions.explanation: If the 'parallel pair' and the 'equal pair' are different pairs, there are counterexamples such as an isosceles trapezoid, so it is not necessarily a parallelogram.
tags: 平行四辺形になる条件

questions.subunit: Conditions for a quadrilateral to be a parallelogram
questions.question: In quadrilateral ABCD, it is known that AB∥DC and AB=DC. What can be said about this quadrilateral?
choices: It can only be said to be a trapezoid
questions.explanation: A quadrilateral with one pair of opposite sides that are parallel and equal in length is a parallelogram.
tags: 平行四辺形になる条件

questions.question: Which of the following is the correct definition of a rectangle?
choices: A quadrilateral in which all four angles are equal
A quadrilateral in which all four sides are equal
A quadrilateral whose diagonals are perpendicular
A quadrilateral in which both pairs of opposite sides are parallel
questions.answer: A quadrilateral in which all four angles are equal
questions.explanation: The definition of a rectangle is 'a quadrilateral in which all four angles are equal (all right angles).' Having all four sides equal describes a rhombus.

questions.question: Which of the following is true about the diagonals of a rhombus?
questions.explanation: The diagonals of a rhombus intersect perpendicularly. Being equal in length is a property of a rectangle.

questions.question: Which parallelogram has diagonals that are equal in length and intersect perpendicularly?
questions.explanation: The figure that has both equal length (a property of a rectangle) and perpendicular intersection (a property of a rhombus) is the square.

questions.question: Which of the following is a correct explanation of the statement 'A square is a rhombus'?
choices: Correct, because a square has four equal sides
Incorrect, because its angles are right angles
Incorrect, because its diagonals are equal
questions.answer: Correct, because a square has four equal sides
questions.explanation: The definition of a rhombus is 'a quadrilateral with four equal sides.' Since a square has four equal sides, it is a special case of a rhombus.

questions.question: If the perimeter of a rhombus is 28 cm, what is the length of one side, in cm? Answer with the number only.
questions.explanation: Since a rhombus has four equal sides, 28÷4=7 cm.

questions.subunit: Properties and conditions of isosceles triangles
questions.question: In isosceles triangle ABC with AB=AC, if the exterior angle at ∠A is 100°, what is the measure of the base angle ∠B, in degrees?
questions.explanation: The exterior angle of 100° equals ∠B+∠C. Since ∠B=∠C, ∠B=100°÷2=50°.

questions.question: In parallelogram ABCD, if the perimeter is 30 cm and AB=7 cm, what is the length of BC, in cm? Answer with the number only.
questions.explanation: Since opposite sides are equal, AB+BC=30÷2=15. BC=15-7=8 cm.

questions.question: If the condition '∠A=90°' is added to parallelogram ABCD, what kind of quadrilateral does it become?
questions.explanation: When one angle of a parallelogram becomes a right angle, all four angles become right angles, making it a rectangle.
